name: Ninisanni Scenario
source:
It's Ninisanni Scenario! An unsanctioned, unfiltered high school dating simulator for the modern literary connoisseur, featuring the lovely ladies from Nijisanji EN!

MC-kun is just starting his second year of high school, but he's like, super depressed after breaking up with his supermodel girlfriend.
But then, in a stroke of fate, a fairy godmother appears before him! Apparently, he's altered his future by breaking up with his girlfriend, and if nothing changes, he's set to be childless for the rest of his life! Oh no!
An end to the bloodline is a mortal contention for fairy godmothers, and so this lovely, generous, exceedingly self-sacrificing fairy is determined to help MC-kun [s]get laid[/s] find love by any means necessary!

[From [url=https://dullachan.itch.io/ninisanni-scenario]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这就是《Ninisanni Scenario》！一款未经授权、毫无遮掩的高中恋爱模拟游戏，献给当代的文学鉴赏家，彩虹社EN的可爱姑娘们倾情登场！

主角君刚升上高中二年级，却因为和超模女友分手，陷入了超级低落的情绪。
可就在这时，命运的转机来了：一位仙女教母出现在他面前！原来，与女友分手的举动改变了他的未来；如果不作改变，他这辈子就注定没有孩子！糟糕！
对仙女教母来说，血脉断绝可是天大的事。因此，这位可爱、慷慨、舍己为人到了极点的仙女，下定决心，不惜一切手段，也要帮主角君[s]上床[/s]找到爱情！

[摘自[url=https://dullachan.itch.io/ninisanni-scenario]itch.io[/url]]
